new.title: New
new.description: An 8-year-old boy runs away from home and meets a scientist, who transforms him into a young man of 28, although mentally, he remains a child.

new.title: New
new.description: The beginning of the end and the end of the beginning

new.title: New
new.description: A man dies of cancer—and then wakes up, decades in the future, because his body was cryogenically preserved. Now he’s not only cured of cancer, but also rejuvenated. And his wife is also alive again, restored to health and youth by miraculous future technology. It’s a post-scarcity future, in which the biggest problem is learning how to start over when everything is new and different.

new.title: New
new.description: In Camp New: Act One, Penny tells the story of how she, along with her friends, Nattie, Emmie, and Jess spend their summer working at a creative arts center called All Things New.

new.title: N.E.W.
new.description: N.E.W tells the story of Nate Ethan Watson, the first transgender artist in the UK Grime scene. Struggling with his identity as an emerging female artist, he is confronted with a life-changing decision. Continue his career in music and achieve everything he ever wanted, or be true to himself and live the life he was born to lead A story that encapsulates gender, expression, inner conflict, and celebration.

new.title: New
new.description: Whilst wandering through the streets of Barcelona, a man reflects on the years he spent with a destructive woman and his newfound love for life.

new.title: New
new.description: The girl's morning begins in conflict with her own persona.

new.title: New
new.description: Outskirts of Moscow. A girl comes to an unfamiliar apartment to look after a dog. After a while, she realizes that the owner of the apartment has disappeared. She finds herself into a series of people that have been taking care of the dog for years in that same apartment, creating a weird community around this strange absence of the owner.

new.title: News of the World
new.description: In post-Civil-War Texas, a wandering traveler reads news from newspapers to townspeople and helps keep their communities informed. When he encounters a young girl who has been kidnapped, he agrees to guide her toward safety, facing harsh conditions and mounting danger across the West.

new.title: New Year's Eve
new.description: The lives of several couples and singles in New York intertwine on New Year’s Eve as they juggle relationships, resolutions, and last-minute plans. As the night builds toward midnight, the stories overlap in unexpected ways.

new.title: New World
new.description: An undercover cop faces growing pressure when the leader of a corporate crime group he’s infiltrating dies. With power struggles closing in, his loyalties are tested as he’s pulled between two worlds and forced to keep making hard choices.

new.title: Newtopia
new.description: A couple breaks up by phone over misunderstandings right as a zombie outbreak upends the world. With a national emergency and a crash that traps one man atop a Seoul skyscraper, his partner searches through the danger to reach him.

new.title: New Police Story
new.description: A disgraced Hong Kong police inspector spirals after his unit is wiped out by a gang of thrill-seeking punks. With help from a new rookie partner and his own troubles, he tries to claw his way back to track down the gang and its ruthless leader.

new.title: New Amsterdam
new.description: A new medical director arrives at America’s oldest public hospital and tries to tear up bureaucracy to improve care. With doctors and staff skeptical, he insists on changing the underfunded system anyway, driven by a simple mindset: keep finding ways to help people and prove he can make a difference.

new.title: New Girl
new.description: After a rough breakup, a quirky, optimistic woman in her late 20s moves into a loft with three single men. As they adjust to living together, everyday mishaps and friendships push everyone out of their comfort zones, blending awkward humor with moments of warmth and honesty.

new.title: New Jack City
new.description: A ruthless drug dealer builds a powerful empire in New York, drawing police attention as the city is torn apart by crack and violence. To bring the operation down, an undercover cop has to get close enough to learn how it works from the inside.

new.title: New York, I Love You
new.description: New York, I Love You follows New Yorkers as they navigate the ups and downs of love, from first sparks to complicated feelings. The movie moves through different neighborhoods in New York City, collecting many short stories where people of all ages search for romance in the Big Apple.

new.title: Newsies
new.description: Set in turn-of-the-century New York, the story follows exploited child newspaper sellers whose lives are upended when their publisher pushes for more profit. Tension rises as the boys organize a strike, only to face intense opposition and hard-ball tactics from those in charge.

new.title: New Order
new.description: In a near future where unrest sweeps through Mexico City, a wedding at a wealthy family’s home is interrupted. After the violence is contained, the family learns the bride has vanished and turns to the military for help finding her.

new.title: New Kids Turbo
new.description: Five friends from Maaskantje lose their jobs due to the economic crisis, and decide they won’t pay for anything anymore. Their refusal spirals into trouble with authorities as they keep causing chaos and defending their town.

avengers.title: Avengers Assemble
avengers.description: A team of Earth’s biggest heroes joins forces to face threats no one hero could handle alone. Across fast-paced missions and ongoing rivalries, they balance clashing personalities, teamwork, and world-saving battles against powerful enemies that keep raising the stakes.

avengers.title: The Avengers
avengers.description: When an unexpected threat endangers global safety, Nick Fury’s peacekeeping agency seeks a team to stop the chaos and pull the world back from disaster. The recruitment unfolds across the globe as unlikely allies are brought together for a high-stakes mission.

avengers.title: The Avengers
avengers.description: A British Ministry agent investigates a plot to rule the world using a weather-control machine. On the trail, he crosses paths with a stylish doctor who becomes both a suspect and an unlikely ally as they work to stop a growing threat over London.

avengers.title: The Avengers
avengers.description: The Avengers is a quirky British spy series about a suave gentleman agent teaming up with different partners as they track down outrageous threats. Episodes blend mystery, adventure, and science-fiction twists, with the duo repeatedly stepping in to stop diabolical schemes—from robots and monsters to surreal plots that threaten the world.

avengers.title: The Avengers
avengers.description: When Hitler invades Poland, sports journalist Colin Metcalfe (Hugh Williams) is unexpectedly reassigned as a foreign correspondent in Norway. En route, his ship is attacked by a German U-boat, but his warning to the Royal Navy is dismissed and he loses his post. With the German invasion of Norway soon after, Metcalfe returns, determined to uncover enemy operations and strike back against the occupiers.  (Note: The film was released in the United States under the alternate title The Avengers (1942).)

avengers.title: The Avengers
avengers.description: The attractive Argentine Don Careless is an adventurer and an excellent swordsman. Don is in love with Maria Moreno, since he had to emerge her jewels and had thereby to kill a shark. Don tries to prevent the forced marriage of Mary with the ruthless revolutionary Colonel Luis Corral. An armed clash between Don and Luis seems inevitable.

avengers.title: Avengers: Endgame
avengers.description: After the fallout of Avengers: Infinity War leaves the universe in ruins, the remaining allies band together to undo Thanos’ actions. With the stakes hanging over everything, the Avengers must assemble again and restore order to the cosmos, no matter what consequences they face.

avengers.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
avengers.description: A risky attempt to create a new peacekeeping system goes wrong, forcing a team of superheroes to face a powerful threat with global consequences. As tensions rise and alliances shift, they must work together to stop a plan that could endanger the entire planet.

avengers.title: Avengers: Infinity War
avengers.description: The Avengers and their allies face a new cosmic threat determined to gather powerful artifacts and reshape reality. As the danger grows, heroes from across the universe are pulled into one desperate fight where the fate of Earth and everything beyond hangs in the balance.

avengers.title: Avengers Confidential: Black Widow & Punisher
avengers.description: After taking down a black-market weapons dealer, a hard-edged vigilante uncovers a much larger terrorist scheme tied to a shadowy group. Teaming up with an elite spy, the two race to stop the threat before it spreads beyond their control.

avengers.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
avengers.description: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga. Plot TBA.

avengers.title: Avengers: Doomsday
avengers.description: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

avengers.title: Avengers Grimm
avengers.description: A group of fairy-tale heroines is pulled into the modern world after a magical portal is shattered. With powers and combat skills, they must stop a dangerous enemy and his followers from spreading their rule across Earth.

avengers.title: Avengers of Justice: Farce Wars
avengers.description: While trying to remain a good husband and father, Superbat recruits the Avengers of Justice out of retirement to stop Dark Jokester and Lisp Luthor from freezing the planet.

avengers.title: Avengers Grimm: Time Wars
avengers.description: When Rumpelstiltskin tries to take over Earth once and for all, The Avengers Grimm must track him down through time in order to defeat him.

avengers.title: Avengers Social Club
avengers.description: Women gather power to revenge on targets, as well as uncover social injustice.

avengers.title: The Avengers: United They Stand
avengers.description: When the planet is threatened by Super Villains, time traveling conquerors, alien invaders, mythical monsters or mad robots bent on the total destruction of humanity, when the forces of evil are so overwhelming that no single hero has the power to save the world, when there is no hope left… the AVENGERS ASSEMBLE!

avengers.title: Avengers: Quantum Encounter
avengers.description: While Ant-Man and Wasp demo their Quantum Core, an unexpected villain shows up eager to get their hands on the powerful tech. The heroes need all the help they can get to save the day.

avengers.title: Avengers S.T.A.T.I.O.N.
avengers.description: Director:  Nicholas Cooper

avengers.title: Avengers: Secret Wars (Shorts)
avengers.description: With Tony Stark trapped in another dimension, the Avengers muster all of their powers to try and bring him back. But before they can, they are attacked by a new cabal of villains.

avengers.title: Avengers Disassembled
avengers.description: It's Team Captain America versus Team Iron Man in parts 1 and 2 of Avengers Disassembled!

avengers.title: Avengers from Hell
avengers.description: Three macabre short stories about gambling, vengeance and homicide.

avengers.title: Avengers Assemble: Captain America
avengers.description: It's time to celebrate the best of the best, the Avengers Heroes that have saved the Earth from mortal danger (more times than we can count). Known as the Super Soldier, Captain America lives up to his name. From infiltrating the enemy in disguise to being the last one standing in a fight, Steve Rogers is the epitome of a hero.

avengers.title: Avengers of the Reef
avengers.description: This Australian children's film is about scientist Bill Stewart goes to Fiji with his son Tim to investigate the appearance of the Crown of Thorns starfish in the reefs off the island.

avengers.title: Marvel's Avengers: Mightiest Friends
avengers.description: The series introduces kid versions of Earth's Mightiest Heroes: Iron Man, Captain America, Hulk, Black Panther, Black Widow and Thor. Together, the young Avengers strive to be their best selves while facing off against classic Super Baddies.

avengers.title: The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes
avengers.description: Powerful villains break out and the heroes struggle to stop them, even with support from major organizations. As the threat grows, the team comes together to fight evil and learns that their strength multiplies when they work as one.

avengers.title: The Avengers: A Visual Journey
avengers.description: Joss Whedon and others in interviews discussing the aims for this new franchise.

avengers.title: The Avengers vs. A.I.M.
avengers.description: Ahead of production for 2008's Iron Man, Marvel performed focus group research that shed light on Iron Man's awareness issues, especially among kids. One of the major takeaways of the studies was that children unfamiliar with the character were quick to dismiss him as a robot, but their interest skyrocketed if they were made aware that he is a person wearing armor.

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: After a child disappears, several families in a small town launch a frantic search that quickly turns into a mind-bending mystery. The investigation stretches across years, gradually revealing connections that link past and present in unexpected ways.

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: Dark, the debut feature film of up-and-coming Chicago-based indie filmmaker Darryl Bullock, became an official selection at the 2003 Toronto International Film Festival, Chicago International Film Festival, Urbanworld Film Festival, and American Black Film Festival, and receives its first home video release from Cheeseburger Films. It tells the story of one Dark Freeman (Jason Bonner), a young African American man who finds himself torn between his tough urban roots - living as a resident on the impoverished, crime-ridden south side of Chicago - and his day-to-day life, in the comparatively wealthy and privileged University of Chicago, where he is enrolled as a student. Walking between the two worlds, Freeman must find a way to succeed in both, with the help of lovers, family members, close friends and acquaintances.

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: A disturbed young woman must confront her worst fears when she finds herself trapped alone in a New York City loft during the 2003 blackout.

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: Nightmare school, nightmare at school. When Tim, Evelyn and Niclas have to write an exam, strange things happen: The supervisor disappears without a trace, the night is overwhelmed by a deep dark, a black man scurries through the corridors, and the building itself floats detached in the void. To escape this nirvana, the three teenagers have to face their own fears. But do you dare to ...?

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: "Sid has to kill and drink the blood of a human tonight. If he refuses to, he will suffer horrifying consequences"

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: Shinji Yagami had always heard the rumors about female students being raped on campus - everyone did. Of course he never believed them until the day he stumbled across a website showing detailed pictures of female students being assaulted in the classrooms. Shocked to find himself turned on by what he sees, Shinji begins his descent into a world of voyeurism, S&M, and rape guided by fellow sadist Satoshi Kojima.

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: Dark Canary is beyond frustrated with the uptick of crime and specifically kidnapping and sex trafficking. Dr. Klepto is one of the biggest perpetrators and the authorities seem powerless to handle things. Even though she's warned not to interfere, when she receives an anonymous tip, she takes matters into her own hands and confronts Klepto and his thugs. The thugs are one thing and can be easily handled, but the addition of Klepto and some very powerful chloro tips the scales against her. After getting KO'd, she wakes with a neck piece attached negating her cry. Without her powers, she's no match for the thugs and they don't hold back. It's all downhill as things go from bad to worse. Klepto realizes if he can subdue her, she could bring a very attractive profit on the black market. If only DC had let the authorities handle things.

dark.title: Dark
dark.description: Award-winning Faber and Faber poetry-film director Jane Glennie came together with poet James E. Kenward on ‘Dark’, made with Jane’s unique photo-collage style. The soundtrack features a fresh piano-arrangement of Stravinsky’s ‘The Rite of Spring’ dueted with the spoken poem ‘Dark’. Jane took a year to hone her response, in the medium of light, to a poem about the dark. ‘Dark’ has gone on to play in festivals all over the world.  There is something magical in the coming together of all the different art-forms in this production.  In some ways the film provides a momentary solution to an age old puzzle that is so much a part of our lives. How to be with the dark itself? Must we always reach for the light?

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: A mother travels with her young daughter to the Welsh coast hoping to mend family ties. After the child vanishes at sea, unsettling clues and local folklore pull the family into a grim mystery, where a lookalike girl appears and the search points toward something beyond the ordinary world.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: In a remote forest, an undead young woman who preys on trespassers finds an abused boy hiding in a car trunk. Sparing him disrupts her lonely routine and pushes the story toward a bleak, emotional mix of horror, empathy, and the search for lost humanity.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: At night the Mangler stalks the streets of Los Angeles, killing and mutilating random victims. On the trail are a TV reporter, the father of one of the victims, and a police detective, but despite their efforts only the mysterious psychic DeRenzy knows what the killer is and how to stop it.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: Something is alive beneath the surface of the graveyard. Something with the power to destroy and the power to heal. One man, a cop, is determined to kill this mysterious creature. Another, a scientist, is determined to capture and save this miraculous being. Stalking the creature in it's subterranean habitat, neither man is aware of the battle they are about to start. A battle for science, survival and revenge.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: During the Covid-19 lockdowns, a man runs from home and heads for a remote mountain, hoping isolation will keep him safe and help him reconnect with better memories. When a stranger emerges from the surrounding woods, his refuge starts to feel far more threatening than he expected.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: After a sudden tragedy, a young woman purchases a candle that allows her to contact the dead.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: The Dark takes place over a period of 36 hours, on the first day of summer. Taxi driver Frane lives together with his sister and her husband in an unusual strange domestic arrangement. Frane learns that his sister is pregnant and he is not sure how he feels about the baby that she is expecting. After his night shift Frane kills a young unknown woman while he is having sex with her. He tries to cover up all traces of the crime, but in doing so he commits two further murders, one of which goes wrong. Throughout the film, the victims tell their stories at the places where the murders took place. On the morning of the summer solstice Frane thinks he has managed to get away with his crimes and he goes with his sister and her husband for a picnic in the forest by the river, not knowing what awaits him there.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: As a family tradition every year on his birthday, a Daughter takes a picture of her Father. The Mother is a memory, a portrait looking back from the wall of the dark room. As the picture develops, a mystery emerges from the darkness which threatens to bring the past sharply back into focus.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: A lonely young monster with deadly black eyes encounters a kidnapped and abused young boy whose eyes have been sewn shut.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: A young woman comes to find a dark presence in her apartment, while alone at night.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: When the body of a young man is found eerily staged in the idyllic Scottish wilderness, she fears this is the beginning of a terrifying campaign that will strike at the heart of a rural community. As paranoia rises, suspicions and secrets are forced into the light, and the locals start to realize there is a serial killer hidden amongst them.

dark.title: The Dark
dark.description: The film follows college student, Rowan (Caden Aiello), as he struggles against his fear of the unknown.

dark.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
dark.description: The X-Men face a terrifying new threat when one of their own starts to spiral after a mysterious cosmic force leaves her vastly more powerful but unstable. To stop it from being exploited by aliens, the team must unite to help her and confront those who want to use her abilities to reshape the galaxy.

dark.title: Dark Waters
dark.description: A determined lawyer begins investigating a wave of unexplained illnesses and deaths tied to a powerful chemical company. As the evidence grows, the fight to hold the corporation accountable becomes a long, exhausting battle that threatens his career, his family life, and his own safety.

dark.title: Dark Shadows
dark.description: A vampire is accidentally freed from his tomb and steps into a drastically changed 1972, returning to Collinwood Manor. He finds the estate and family that once defined him are now in ruin, forcing him to confront a world that has moved on without him.

dark.title: Darkest Hour
dark.description: In May 1940, a beleaguered leader at the start of WWII must weigh whether to negotiate or to keep fighting, knowing the choice could reshape the fate of the British Empire. Set during a critical stretch of government decision-making, the story focuses on the pressure of holding a nation together.

dark.title: Dark Matter
dark.description: A man is abducted into an alternate version of his life and must navigate a harrowing journey to reunite with his true family. Facing the most terrifying foe imaginable, he fights to escape a reality that’s been turned against him.

action.title: Action
action.description: After a terror attack causes a painful personal loss, a determined army officer sets out to track down the mastermind behind it. The mission becomes a fast-moving chase built around revenge, danger, and high-stakes action.

action.title: Action
action.description: A ruthless Hollywood producer scrambles to keep his career afloat while pushing a new action movie through a world of ego, backstabbing, and nonstop compromise. The show skewers the industry with sharp, often crude satire, spotlighting how power, favors, and dishonesty shape what ends up on screen.

action.title: Action
action.description: Z-movie actor Bruno Martel has hero syndrome, often quarrelling with directors. He meets fellow actor Doris, who is obsessed with Ophelia but cannot get any Shakespearean bookings. One day, during a nervous breakdown, Bruno 'rescues' Doris from the set, leaving town to encounter various absurd situations.

action.title: Action
action.description: An adrenaline-fueled docuseries following filmmaker David Leitch and Kelly McCormick's 87North stunt team as they take center stage.

action.title: Action
action.description: Four guys head to Goa for a bachelor’s party, wake up with a huge hangover and realise things have gone awry.

action.title: Action
action.description: An American action star from the 90's is shooting a movie in Bulgaria, while three of his (now grown up) fans try to meet their childhood idol. After a series of bad decisions, the three fans are between the Russian mafia, huge amount of drugs, and huge debt. So they decide to rob the Hollywood production which their childhood idol is shooting.

action.title: Action
action.description: This four-part docu-series explores the legalization of sports gambling and its evolving impact on the gambling community. It chronicles professional gamblers, bookies, oddsmakers and documents effects of legalization through their eyes.

action.title: Action
action.description: On a film set, there are always unforeseen events. Some days, it's all there is. And sometimes it's even worse.

action.title: Action
action.description: A model plays a small drum with a mallet.

action.title: Action
action.description: Three Outlaws came across a stranded baby and must decide to save the child or escape from the law.

action.title: Action
action.description: Exploring transgender and non-binary representations through an autoethnographic video essay-documentary form, including the voices of transgender and non-binary participants with a variety of filmmaking experiences.

action.title: Action!
action.description: In the final year of high school, a group of students embarks on creating a short film for a competition. Despite facing numerous obstacles and challenges that test their teamwork and unity, the group learns valuable lessons in persistence and collaboration. As tensions rise and doubts creep in, one member reminds them that struggles are part of the journey. Together, they push forward, determined to finish what they started. This film, made as a keepsake for their graduation, captures not only the struggles they faced but the triumph of overcoming them.

action.title: Action!
action.description: Aspiring filmmaker So Yee is working part-time on a movie set. There, she runs into Kyung Min, her ex-girlfriend and the lead actor of the one movie she has made. So Yee tries to avoid Kyung Min, but it is hard to do so while being a camera assistant. A short film about avoiding ex-girlfriends, trying to read the director's mind, and struggling to eat at the movie set.

action.title: Action!
action.description: At the heart of the story is the clapperboard, the beginning and end of every magical shot. A symphony.

action.title: Action
action.description: Sayantan Mukherjee’s Action stays true to its name. There’s enough dhishoom-dhishoom, enough drama, enough glam quotient… and enough action. When Raka (Barkha Sengupta), a hot, 20-something, gun-toting coal-mafia’s amorous advents are rejected by college-goer Akash (Om), she turns his life into a living hell. So, Akash, along with his family, flees Ranigunj in order to escape Raka’s wrath and joins a college in Kolkata under the alias of Rohit Roy. Here, he meets Rini (Megha Chakraborty) and romance blooms. But is Raka ready to let go off Akash so soon?

action.title: Action!
action.description: Rushes of film scenes. The countryside. A father with two children. The same clapperboard on-screen over and over. Starting afresh again.

action.title: Action!
action.description: Star troupe's skits.

action.title: Action!
action.description: Mia sets out to Film her own movie. Justin documents the making of the film. Things go off script. Shea begins killing the cast in order to make his own film.

action.title: Action
action.description: A young college filmmaker is setting up their camera to film their first short film ever.

action.title: Action!
action.description: Frustrated filmmakers and couple, Pat and Nik, just stole one million pesos from a dangerous man, named Dado, so they can fund their next film. Believing they got off the hook, they stay temporarily in a coffee shop to brainstorm and plan their next move in producing their dream movie.

action.title: ACTION !
action.description: Sami is a young man who is about to go to film school with the help of his uncle. After two years, he releases his first short film that is butchered by critics. Sami falls into a severe depression and starts doubting himself and the path he chose...

action.title: Action!!!
action.description: One day, the cafe where Kevin works is borrowed as a filming location. At an unexpected time, Kevin meets Ranni, one of the make-up artists in the production crew. At the same time the clapper closes, they then imagine as if they were in a movie and do various romantic scenes. But when they are free from their imagination, they have to face the awkwardness and embarrassment of getting to know each other.

love.title: Love
love.description: Set in Paris, an American man enters a highly sexual and emotionally charged relationship with a volatile partner. Their neighbor is drawn into their life as their bond becomes increasingly unstable, with the relationship’s impact building in unsettling ways.

love.title: Love
love.description: Rebellious Mickey and good-natured Gus navigate the thrills and agonies of modern relationships in contemporary California. The show mixes messy feelings with subtle humor, focusing on how real-life connection can be both relatable and exhausting.

love.title: Love
love.description: After contact with Earth is lost, an astronaut is left alone aboard the International Space Station with dwindling life support. As isolation and routine wear them down, they struggle to stay sane and alive, until an unsettling discovery on the station hints at a larger mystery.

love.title: Love
love.description: Two healthcare workers who steer clear of conventional relationships cross paths on a ferry and begin rethinking what intimacy, commitment, and connection can look like. Their conversations and experiences gently challenge social expectations around sex, love, and personal freedom.

love.title: Love
love.description: Set across Taipei and Beijing, this ensemble romance follows several interconnected people trying to fill the emptiness in their lives through love. As friendships, family ties, and romantic hopes overlap, the film explores both the comfort and complications that come with searching for connection.

love.title: Love
love.description: This Italian drama anthology tells two separate stories, one adapted from a stage play and the other from a novel. Together, they explore intense personal emotion and faith through intimate, character-driven situations that unfold in very different settings and tones.

love.title: Love
love.description: A young couple falls deeply in love, but their relationship faces strong resistance from the woman’s family because of the man’s troubled, violent past. As they refuse to separate, family pressure and legal trouble threaten their future together.

love.title: Love
love.description: In Imperial Russia, Anna Karenina falls in love with the dashing military officer Count Vronsky and abandons her husband and child to become his mistress.

love.title: Love
love.description: Love Hotel. The best place to spend your holiday on February 14th. So this time the doors of the hotel are open for everyone who wants to make Valentine's Day special, wants to believe in love again, or at least not be alone on this day. Former classmates meet at a restaurant in honor of the 40th anniversary of graduation and old feelings flare up with renewed vigor. A jealous man tries to enter all the rooms on the floor to find his missing wife. A private detective and his attractive client arrange a spy show with wiretaps to bring out the scoundrel husband. An immigrant maid from Uzbekistan chooses between love for her young boy and money from his mother, given for her immediate flight home. And the life of a humble student who dreams of becoming a man in just one hour will never be the same after meeting the most talkative night butterfly in the city ...

love.title: L-O-V-E.
love.description: Four love stories by four talented Taiwanese first-time directors – well-known lyrist, Vincent Fang Wenshan; TV host, Huang Zijiao; online novelist, Jiu BaDao; and commercial director, Chen Yixian.

love.title: Love
love.description: Ganga, who mistakes Vikram to be a womaniser, understands his character when he saves her from a fire accident. They become lovers, but things change when a mysterious woman enters their lives.

love.title: Love
love.description: "Fatty", a poor good hearted farm boy is deeply in love with Winifred, a farmer's daughter. A rich neighbor offers the farmer a large plot of land if Winifred marries his slow witted son Al. "Fatty" has less then one day to save heartbroken Winifred from the rushed ceremony.

love.title: Love
love.description: A short experimental anime about a woman desperately in love. Made by Yoji Kuri, a well-known Japanese indie animator.

love.title: Love
love.description: A unique anthology of six short vignettes on the subject of love, all of them written, directed and produced by women.

love.title: Love
love.description: In 1950s Hungary, a woman cares for her ailing mother-in-law while quietly enduring pressure from authorities and the strain of poverty. As she waits for news of her imprisoned husband, she keeps hope alive through small kindnesses and carefully chosen stories meant to protect the fragile household.

love.title: Love
love.description: The story of a family and the various situations navigated by a husband and wife.

love.title: Love
love.description: In New York, an absurd coincidence links the lives of a Yugoslavian hitman, his ex-wife and her new partner, a policeman whose father was a criminal. His code name is "Uncle Vanya". He grew up in Bosnia, an orphan of both parents and, having never met them, he does not know whether he is a Serb, a Croat or a Muslim. A victim of his fate and his past in war-torn Bosnia, he has become a hitman. He would like to stop killing but he can't.

love.title: Love
love.description: Two Moscow students are mostly concerned with scoring with women but their lives change radically when one of them falls for a Jewish girl whose family is being persecuted by anonymous anti-Semites and is preparing to emigrate to Israel.

love.title: #love
love.description: A playful clash of personalities turns into unexpected romance when two young people discover love beyond trends and appearances in Hashtag Love.

love.title: Lóve
love.description: A car thief driven by a love of cash finds his priorities shift when he falls for a college student but his conversion has dangerous consequences.

love.title: Love

love.description: Love is a 2008 Indonesian anthology romance film directed by Kabir Bhatia as a remake of the 2006 film Cinta .  In Jakarta, five couples of varying ages and backgrounds experience the different stages of romantic love, from its giddy start to its painful end.

love.title: Love
love.description: LOVE explores the relationship between friends, family, and lovers. This story begins with the origins of a blossoming friendship between two 10-year-old girls. Unfortunately, the childhood friends are suddenly separated due to the death of one of their brothers, then later reunited as young adults. Nhi is now a university student and the lead singer of a girl band. She has a handsome but uptight boyfriend, Hoang. On the other hand, Tu comes from a family whose father is struggling with depression and whose mother is working very long hours just to make ends meet. Tu is secretly loved by Mien, a colleague of Nhi. As the story progresses, the girls soon discover feelings that they did not know they had. They must decide if their feelings for one another are just as friends, or perhaps something more.
